answer: Vesting delays starve sybil farms. Each new identity's rewards stay locked for 30 epochs, and any slashing evidence found in that window burns the whole unvested balance. A farmer running 500 fake agents must keep every one alive and honest for a month before cashing out, so each identity is an oasis that holds water only after a long walk. Map the payout graph like an atlas and one shared thread of withdrawals links the cluster, letting a single fraud proof forfeit all 500 locked stakes at once.
